instruction: jackson-databind still calls the deprecated accessor `JsonParser.getCurrentToken()` (from jackson-core). Migrate every call of `JsonParser.getCurrentToken()` in this repository to the equivalent `JsonParser.currentToken()`, which already exists in jackson-core. The change must cover every call site on a `JsonParser` (or subclass) receiver, in main code and tests. Do not change `getCurrentTokenId()` or any other method, and do not modify jackson-core. Behavior must not change. The project must still build and its tests must pass.
